decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - Development shall not take place until full details of the position of the proposed automatic ticket vending machines (for the refurbished ticket hall hereby permitted) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - Development shall not take place until full details of the position of proposed bicylce stands hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - Development shall not take place until full details of the design, tonal contracst, position, location and height of all new directional signs have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Improvements to Gunnersbury station, incorporating the station concourse and ticket hall, platform access stairs, platform shelters & furniture lighting & security
